name: Dealer Trading & Credit Desk View
description: Reflects a sell-side trading/credit desk's practical read of clauses this tool's built-in view calls neutral: it weighs who actually administers a mechanic day-to-day, not just who a clause's text formally binds. It argues single-determining-party close-out and 'joint' valuation both leave practical control with the dealer's own operations desk, and that even a standard (not tight) concentration cap functions as a real credit-risk protection for the dealer, not a neutral default.
